description:
War Room
Tracks every war in the Sector in one Intel screen entry.
v0.15.0 for Starsector 0.98a-RC8

Download: latest release (GitHub)
Requires: LazyLib, Nexerelin

What you get

Hostilities: every active war. Who leads, who is gaining, battles, captured colonies, ships lost.
War reports: one per war. Event log, turning points, battle locations, strength comparison.
Archive: timeline of all wars, plus a log of every event and Sector news.
Faction pages: one faction's or alliance's wars and record. Click any flag or name.
Standings: factions and alliances ranked by colonies, territory won and lost, and wars.
Briefing: how war weariness, peace, alliances and the war score work.

Screenshots (click one to enlarge)

Hostilities Example Faction Page Example

Update 0.15.0

New: the line under the title shows what happened since your last look. Hover it for the list of events.
New: faction tooltips say who the faction is at war with.
New: hover "Colonies captured" (war cards, war reports, alliance wars) to see which colonies, with sizes and dates.
New: Version Checker support: mod managers such as TriOS see new releases.
Fixed: a faction's first colony taken in an invasion (for example a Nexerelin respawn) now counts in its war.
Fixed: successful saturation bombardments no longer show as failed raids.
Fixed: the intercept line names both sides of a peace and no longer repeats a faction's loss.
Fixed: sorting of alliance wars, and colours of older wars on the Archive timeline.
Other: lighter on the game while the Intel screen is open.

Save compatible: update anytime.

Extra info

Records start at install. For the full history, start a new save.
Safe to add to or remove from a running save. Removing it deletes its records.
Pirate wars stay hidden unless you are in them. One click shows them.
Settings live in data/config/settings.json: war score weights, time window, visual extras.

Source: GitHub (MIT license)
Credits: Histidine (Nexerelin), LazyWizard (LazyLib); some icons based on Tabler Icons.

AI use disclaimer
Some assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
* Code: Claude Opus 5.5
* Icons: Claude Opus 5.5 (drawn in code; some shapes based on Tabler Icons)
